project.name: MediQueue
project.vision: Replace paper queue numbers and phone bookings in multi-branch outpatient clinics with online booking and a live queue that patients, front desk and doctors all trust.
goals: Cut median patient wait time from 65 to under 25 minutes
Get at least 60% of visits booked online within 6 months
Keep the no-show rate under 10% through reminders
Keep receptionist handling time per booking under 90 seconds

in: Online appointment booking with slot picking, for the patient or a family member
Walk-in ticket issuing at a self check-in kiosk
Live queue board per consultation room
Doctor consultation console showing the current and next patient
Automatic SMS and email reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before an appointment; expiry of no-show tickets
Clinic admin setup of branches, rooms, doctor schedules and holidays, plus a utilisation report

actors.name: Payment Gateway
actors.description: VietQR provider that takes visit fee payments by QR and reports the result through an asynchronous webhook.

actors.name: SMS Gateway
actors.description: Outbound SMS provider that delivers appointment reminders and queue-turn messages to patients.

actors.name: Email Service
actors.description: Transactional email provider that sends booking confirmations.

actors.name: Medical Record System
actors.description: The clinic's existing electronic medical record system that supplies patient demographics and receives visit summaries through a nightly file exchange.

business_rules.statement: A booked appointment keeps its slot until 10 minutes after the start time, then becomes a no-show.
Patient personal data is encrypted at rest and in transit and every access is audited.

addendum.content: Patients book for themselves or a family member; receptionists at the front desk issue tickets and handle phone bookings; doctors and nurses in consultation rooms call the next patient; clinic administrators manage branches, rooms, schedules and reports.
addendum.content_en: Patients book for themselves or a family member; receptionists at the front desk issue tickets and handle phone bookings; doctors and nurses in consultation rooms call the next patient; clinic administrators manage branches, rooms, schedules and reports.

addendum.content: Patients queue physically from 6am for a paper number, receptionists juggle phone bookings on spreadsheets, doctors have no reliable view of who is next, and owners cannot see utilisation across branches.
addendum.content_en: Patients queue physically from 6am for a paper number, receptionists juggle phone bookings on spreadsheets, doctors have no reliable view of who is next, and owners cannot see utilisation across branches.

addendum.content: VietQR payment gateway (QR payment plus an asynchronous payment-result webhook); an SMS gateway for reminder and queue-turn messages; a transactional email service for booking confirmations; the clinic's existing electronic medical record system, read for patient demographics and written with visit summaries over a nightly file exchange.
addendum.content_en: VietQR payment gateway (QR payment plus an asynchronous payment-result webhook); an SMS gateway for reminder and queue-turn messages; a transactional email service for booking confirmations; the clinic's existing electronic medical record system, read for patient demographics and written with visit summaries over a nightly file exchange.

addendum.content: A background job sends reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before each appointment and expires no-show tickets.
addendum.content_en: A background job sends reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before each appointment and expires no-show tickets.

addendum.content: Walk-in versus booked priority rules differ per branch; some branches need the kiosk to work briefly offline.
